branches.fallbackBehavior: Morpho's fixed feed path has no alternate fallback; ChainlinkDataFeedLib rejects negative answers but ignores updatedAt and does not enforce staleness or min/max bounds. The active Midas implementation has setRoundDataSafe with an hour cooldown and deviation guard, but the same feed-admin role can call setRoundData directly without those two guards. At block 26197000, mWIN round 67 returned answer 13115873583340, updatedAt 1791990383; PYUSD round 36893488147419104092 returned answer 100001387, updatedAt 1792007699, both with 8 feed decimals. Those timestamps are observations, not promised heartbeats or hard freshness limits.
